en: The Thousand-Character Classic in Sanskrit with Preface, composed by the Tripiṭaka Master Yijing.
This preface was written for the purpose of providing a model for study for those wishing to go to the Western Regions; accordingly, the Sanskrit pronunciation is annotated below each character.
For those with Chinese characters,
provide the titles; for those without characters,
correct them according to their pronunciation.
These are all essential characters for contemporary usage;
once one has mastered these, all other language will be understood.
This is unlike the traditional Thousand Character Classic.
If one studies the *Siddham* script alongside reading the Sanskrit original, one will be capable of translating within one or two years. The Thousand-Character Classic in Sanskrit:
